greeting: Hello! I'm your Hourmaker assistant. How can I help you today?

questions.question: What does Hourmaker do?
questions.answer: Hourmaker is a workforce management platform that automates time tracking, scheduling, leave management, and approvals for businesses of all sizes.

questions.question: What are the pricing plans?
questions.answer: We offer Starter (₹599/user/month), Professional (₹1299/user/month), and Enterprise (custom pricing) plans. All include a 14-day free trial.

questions.question: Is there a free trial?
questions.answer: Yes! 14-day free trial of Professional plan with full feature access. No credit card required.

questions.question: What integrations are available?
questions.answer: We integrate with 50+ tools including Slack, Teams, Jira, QuickBooks, Xero, ADP, and Workday. Plus a robust API.

questions.question: What support do you offer?
questions.answer: Email support (Starter), priority support (Professional), 24/7 premium with dedicated manager (Enterprise).

questions.question: How to schedule a demo?
questions.answer: Visit hourmaker.in/demo or chat with us. We'll show the platform and answer your questions personally.

questions.question: Is my data secure?
questions.answer: Yes! Enterprise-grade security with end-to-end encryption, SOC 2 compliance, and regular audits.

questions.question: Can I export my data?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Export in CSV, Excel, or PDF anytime, even after cancellation. No vendor lock-in.
